instruction.text: Emma has to run some errands in town. Follow the instructions and select the correct coordinates to find the places she has to go to.

atoms.a: First, she drives to the farm shop which has the coordinates (<mat>-1</mat>, 5).
From there she drives to the fudge shop six steps to the south and three steps to the west.
After that, she decides to walk to the chemist three steps east and two steps south.
Emma is now hungry. She makes her way to have lunch with a friend at the King’s Arms, which is located at the coordinates (2, <mat>-1</mat>).

instruction.text: Emma has to walk back to the fudge shop to pick up her car after lunch. What are the coordinates of the fudge shop?

atoms.b: The coordinates of the fudge shop are (<mat><gap>-4</gap></mat>, <mat><gap>-1</gap></mat>)

instruction.text: The coordinates of the places Emma went to form a shape. What is it?

atoms.b: The coordinates make a ((trapezium square parallelogram ++kite)).

instruction.text: Leo has gone to the forest for the weekend to get away from the city. Follow the instructions and select the correct coordinates to complete the map.

atoms.a: The house they will stay at can be found at (1, <mat>-2</mat>).
Near to the house, there are lots of mushrooms which can be used for cooking. They can be found at (4, <mat>-3</mat>).
Not far away, there is an orange orchard at (<mat>-4</mat>, <mat>-4</mat>).
In the other part of the forest, the large old oak tree can be found at (<mat>-4</mat>, 2).

instruction.text: Leo reads in the guest book that there is a freshwater lake at the edge of the forest. What are the coordinates of the lake?

atoms.b: The coordinates of the lake are (<mat><gap>4</gap></mat>, <mat><gap>3</gap></mat>)

instruction.text: The old oak tree, the freshwater lake, the mushroom field and the orange orchard surround the house at all sides. The coordinates of these landmarks form a shape, what is it?

atoms.b: The coordinates make a ((triangle square ++parallelogram kite)).

hint.text: A buoy is something which floats in the water. Buoys can be used to mark out specific areas or objects in the water.

instruction.text: Zadie is practising windsurfing. Follow the instructions and select the correct coordinates to find the places they have to go to.

atoms.a: First, they head to the buoy which has the coordinates (3, <mat>-2</mat>).
From there they head to another buoy three steps to the north and two steps to the west.

instruction.text: Zadie is now thirsty. Their bottle of water is located on the west part of the coast. What are the coordinates of their bottle of water?

atoms.b: The coordinates of her bottle of water are (<mat><gap>-3</gap></mat>, <mat><gap>1</gap></mat>)

instruction.text: Zadie wants to go back from where they have started. What are the coordinates of this buoy?
What shape have Zadie’s coordinates formed?
